summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing for BSI ASSET DEAL. 37/37 pytest cases PASSED covering: public catalog (filters, keyword, detail, no-sensitive-fields), auth for 3 roles + wrong password, MA flow (context, create DRAFT with BLC-YYYY-IDENT-000000 numbering, list mine, submit), full approval workflow MA->ACRM->RCG->PUBLISHED including 409 concurrency + ACRM return notes-required, RBAC/IDOR (other MA blocked, other ACR ACRM blocked, cross-role tokens rejected), Admin (list/keyword/HP-validation/mutasi reason required/ACRM mutasi blocks if target has active ACRM/category add+toggle/audit logs/mutation history), KPKNL schedule validation, dashboards for all 3 roles, notifications list+read. Frontend UI verified end-to-end: public catalog (7 cards, category filter chips, search bar), asset detail with WhatsApp button, login screen, admin dashboard (45 ACR / 45 ACRM / 60 MA / 13 assets / per-ACR monitoring table), MA dashboard, ACRM dashboard, role-based bottom tabs render correctly. No console/page errors. Design is clean and mobile-responsive.

minor.issue: acr_identifier() may produce identical identifiers for ACRs with similar names (e.g. 'ACR JAKARTA THAMRIN' -> 'JAKARTATHAMRIN') — unique per row so OK, but no length cap; asset number could be very long.
Requires auth. Public catalog exposes KPKNL name+alamat via /public/catalog/{id}, but /master/kpknl itself is authed — consistent, informational only.
All 6 seeded published assets share the SAME KPKNL (KPKNL Banda Aceh) regardless of asset province — cosmetic seed data inconsistency (Honda Vario in Makassar shows KPKNL Banda Aceh).

issues: Icon-only font (FontAwesome) characters visible as short raw glyphs in DOM audit (\uf18e etc). Render is correct visually; just noise for automation.

action_items: (Optional cosmetic) Fix demo seed data: assign KPKNL matching the asset's province rather than a single hard-coded KPKNL Banda Aceh across all 6 demo assets.
(Optional) Add a testID to the primary bottom-tab items and login form fields to make future automated UI tests more robust (currently text-based selectors work but testIDs are best practice).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~965 lines — approaching the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting into routers (auth.py, marketing.py, acrm.py, rcg.py, admin.py, public.py) for maintainability.
Some routes (upload_image, get_asset_internal) fetch user + ref_id serially with multiple find_one calls; could be cached in a helper.

toggle_user has a subtle issue: activating a Marketing Asset/ACRM sets master row status back to active AND users row status active — but if login user was set inactive by an earlier admin action for another reason, this may unintentionally re-enable. Non-blocking for current tests.

success_rate.frontend: 100% smoke (all 3 role logins + public catalog + asset detail render, WhatsApp CTA present, no console errors)

seed_data_creation: Tests created TEST_-prefixed assets in DB (TEST_Rumah Uji Coba, TEST_workflow_full, TEST_return, TEST_sched, TEST_neg-rejected). One TEST_ category 'TEST_KATEGORI' added by admin. These do NOT interfere with production flows. Public catalog now shows 7 items (6 demo + 1 TEST_workflow_full published).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests use pytest with -n 0 (serial) via addopts overridden on CLI because pytest-xdist would split state-dependent workflow test. The full E2E approval workflow is condensed in TestApprovalWorkflow.test_full_workflow_ma_to_acrm_to_rcg to preserve state within a single worker. Base URL is read from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL with fallback to the preview URL. Frontend uses text-based selectors (get_by_text('Masuk')) because testIDs are not yet added to core inputs/tabs.
rca_of_issue: No blocker issues found. All requested features from the review request are functional. Only cosmetic seed-data note (KPKNL mismatch) and code-organization suggestion (server.py length).
